This app shows the StrideBoard website and sends your daily step totals to it automatically. Just log in: there is nothing to copy or paste.

StrideBoard reads only one kind of health data: your total number of steps for yesterday and today, from Health Connect.

It sends those daily totals, with the date and your personal StrideBoard token, to your school's StrideBoard website, where they appear on your dashboard and the leaderboards.

It does not read your location, heart rate, sleep, workouts or any other health data, and it never writes anything into Health Connect. Your data is not sold or shared with anyone outside the StrideBoard website.

You can stop it at any time: open Health Connect → App permissions → StrideBoard and turn Steps off, or uninstall the app. To delete step history that was already sent, ask your StrideBoard admin.
